recommended_content: Authentic students on campus, with greenery and a recognisable learning setting. Natural light; candid activity rather than staged poses.
crop_guidance: Keep faces and essential details within the central 60%. Allow flexible crops. No embedded slogans or logos.
intended_slot: Hero illustration replacement; final crop must be reviewed at desktop and mobile sizes.

recommended_content: Students reading, talking, or collaborating in a library, shaded campus space, or other genuine student setting.
crop_guidance: Show people in context. Keep faces away from edges; leave room for a narrower mobile crop.

recommended_content: Real departmental teaching, fieldwork, or laboratory activity. Show the discipline and students together.
crop_guidance: Use a wide composition. Keep the subject near centre; avoid text and sensitive information.
intended_slot: Proposed department image slot; current page requires a small markup addition.

recommended_content: Speaker, venue, workshop activity, or an approved thematic photograph. Use actual event information in HTML, not on the image.
crop_guidance: Keep key subjects within the central 70%. Do not use a dense event poster as the only image or description.
intended_slot: Proposed event-card image slot; renderer integration required.

recommended_content: Authentic research: instrumentation, field observations, collections, or students working with researchers.
crop_guidance: Show one clear subject and enough context to explain the work. Avoid confidential screens or unsafe practice.
intended_slot: Optional future research story image slot.

recommended_content: Consented portrait of a real student in a relevant campus setting. Accompany with a verified story and name.
crop_guidance: Portrait orientation. Keep head and shoulders away from edges; natural expression and background.

recommended_content: Consistent professional portrait with soft light and a simple background. Use approved photographs only.
crop_guidance: Head and shoulders; subject centred, with space above the head. Avoid heavy editing or decorative frames.
